subject.title: fix(text): strip plain-text reasoning blocks from user-visible output

question: Should unstructured `Reasoning:` output be normalized by the provider that emits it, or should core apply a generic literal-content sanitizer across all assistant output?
rationale: The branch introduces model-output policy at three shared core boundaries, while the report does not identify a provider contract that safely distinguishes internal reasoning from legitimate answer text.

options.title: Normalize at provider boundary
options.body: Convert the known provider's reasoning envelope into structured reasoning before shared rendering, avoiding content-based guessing across unrelated models.

options.title: Keep a constrained core fallback
options.body: Retain shared sanitization only for an exact leading envelope, with false-positive regressions and live proof for final, streaming, and tool output.

recommendation.title: Normalize at provider boundary
recommendation.body: Convert the known provider's reasoning envelope into structured reasoning before shared rendering, avoiding content-based guessing across unrelated models.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision belongs with the history-backed owner of assistant output normalization and embedded-agent rendering, whose identity could not be safely established from the supplied context alone.
